qualification.text: Reflow is an early-stage standalone Go engine and local proxy for budget-bounded continuation, decoupled from CPA. It holds intermediate outputs while preserving retained tool calls, usage totals, and client-managed login. Integrations are prepared for Codex CLI, app-server, a Codex plugin, and Pi 1.4.0, with local Magpie patches. Its 79 passing regression checks use synthetic upstreams. The aim is reproducible maintenance of cross-client protocol compatibility.

api_credit_use.text: Credits would fund planned maintenance: small-batch, budget-capped API runs checking protocol compatibility, tool-use round-trips, and disconnect recovery. We would reproduce failures, compare upstream versions, review fixes, and validate releases. These proposed API workloads are separate from our previous ChatGPT subscription tests, which are not an API-spend baseline.

additional_context.text: The source is public; no packaged release or verified adoption data yet. Eleven native-login sessions produced 64 inference requests and two continuations. One recent run continued, returned a matching tool result, scored 18/18 and ended normally, but two command failures prevent strict acceptance. The later diagnostic finished without continuation. Successful tool execution after continuation still needs proof. Desktop/dot UI is pending; local Magpie patches are not submitted upstream.

facts_to_preserve: Synthetic upstream checks are not real-account acceptance

A later diagnostic finished 18/18 with zero continuations and one unclassified command failure. Strict acceptance remains incomplete; native totals are eleven sessions, 64 inference requests, two continuations.
